csv_project_name: Design for UNT Health Frisco Inspire Park Renov & Exp PH 1
csv_scope_of_work: The University of North Texas System (UNTS) subsequently referred to as the Owner, requests firms qualifications for Professional Services to facilitate the Programming and Design Services for renovation to support the expansion of academic programs at a new off-site campus location. UNT Health is seeking to expand academic programs at the UNT Frisco Inspire Park campus. To accommodate this expansion, renovations to UNT Inspire Park will be performed. This will be a phased project with the initial phase providing 20,000 square feet of general academic classrooms, specialized class laboratories, and associated support spaces for Texas College of Osteopathic Medicine (TCOM), Nursing and other future programs including a teaching anatomy lab and simulation center.
